parsed.text: Summary: Panel p0 current (represented_time 12) contains inherited prior distributions for nodes n0–n2 and a history estimate for n3. Current p0: n0 — blue peaks at (0,1) (peak ~0.99996), red peaks at (0,3) (peak ~0.99971); n1 and n2 — both roles uniform over all 16 cells (tie peaks); n3 — blue peaks at (1,2) (peak ~0.99958), red peaks at (0,1) (peak ~0.99370). Panel p0 candidate records (k0,k1,k2) repeat the same n0–n2 distributions; their conditional estimates at n3 differ by command as supplied (these are conditional records, not executed events). Panel p1 current (completed record, represented_time 12) matches p0 for n0–n2 and is uniform at n3. Panel p1 candidates present alternative conditional estimates at n3: k0 concentrates blue on {(0,2),(0,3),(1,2),(1,3)} and red on {(0,0),(0,1),(1,0),(1,1)}; k1 is uniform at n3; k2 concentrates blue at (1,2) and red at (0,1). Copied prior records are not new estimates; conditional command records are not events that have already occurred.
